children: said in an investor presentation on Monday that its pretax income is expected to be lower quarter-over-quarter in the production segment.
"With mortgage rates up 50 basis points from June 30th, pretax income will be lower than Q2 primarily due to a decline in pull-through-adjusted lock volume," said the mortgage finance firm.
Revenue margin is expected to be in the range of 75 - 85 basis points, compared to 77 basis points in the previous quarter.
In the servicing segment, pretax income is expected to be higher than in Q2.
Corporate pretax loss is expected to be similar to the year-ago quarter.

title: PennyMac Financial sees Q3 production pretax income declining Q/Q as mortgage rates rise
